19: One is not to obtain the release of captives using money more than their value, to keep a normal state of matters, so that the enemies [=the government officials] do not kidnap more so as to gain more money. However, a person may redeem himself with as much money as he wants. A scholar of Torah and even a sharp student who is only destined to become a scholar of Torah may be redeemed [even with over paying.] (And for if one's wife counts as a separate individual: see the Tur Even Haezer 78.)
